name: frihet-erp
description: AI-native ERP for Spain & the EU. Connect your assistant to invoicing, expenses, clients and business workflows in Frihet. Availability depends on your workspace configuration and permissions.

FRIHET_DEMO.title: Use synthetic demo data
FRIHET_DEMO.description: 0 connects to your Frihet workspace and requires an API key. 1 uses fixed example data without an API key or live API requests; simulated changes are not saved.

FRIHET_API_KEY.title: Frihet API key
FRIHET_API_KEY.description: Required for live mode (FRIHET_DEMO=0). Leave empty for demo mode. Set it only in the host plugin configuration, never in chat.
